content.short: MomoAI is a pioneering AI-driven social gaming platform on Solana and TON featuring viral Telegram-integrated mini-games and MTOS.
content.description: MomoAI is a pioneering Web3 social gaming platform that leverages artificial intelligence to create immersive and viral gaming experiences. Operating across the Solana and TON networks, the platform is renowned for its lightweight mini-games, such as the popular tree-growing simulator "MOMO," which are accessible directly through Telegram and web browsers. MomoAI utilizes advanced AI agents to enhance gameplay mechanics, create dynamic NPCs, and provide personalized rewards for its users. The ecosystem is powered by the MTOS token, which facilitates in-game transactions, governance, and incentive coordination for the next generation of decentralized gamers.
content.meta: MomoAI provides AI-powered social gaming and viral Telegram-integrated mini-games on Solana and TON. Discover MomoAI on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
